College of Agriculture Baseri Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for College of Agriculture Baseri Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty position at College of Agriculture Baseri?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Guest Faculty position is 28th September 2026. Candidates are required to appear for a walk-in interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Guest Faculty post is a Post Graduate (PG) Degree in the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Guest Faculty position is not more than 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q4. How will the Guest Faculty be selected?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty position will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 600/- per class for theory and Rs. 800/- per class for practical, with maximum payments per credit hour specified.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies in support of your claim to age, qualification, and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The venue for the walk-in interview is the Dean Office, College of Agriculture, Baseri, Dholpur.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is F () /COA-Bas./2026/905.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job for the position of Guest Faculty.
